# OpenResearchAssets · Agent navigation

> 中文权威说明：https://openresearchassets.github.io/for-agents/
> Low-token discovery: https://openresearchassets.github.io/catalog/manifest.json
> Canonical catalog: https://openresearchassets.github.io/catalog/index.json

OpenResearchAssets curates reusable research references, editable diagrams, workflows and research-quality guidance. It is Chinese-first with supporting English descriptions. Never assume a third-party figure or webpage screenshot is licensed for redistribution.

## Two primary asset tracks
- [Research Gallery (high-aesthetic scientific visuals)](https://openresearchassets.github.io/#gallery)
- [Research Skills / Workflows (public GitHub stars and evidenced practice)](https://openresearchassets.github.io/#skills)

For skills, inspect each entry's `curation.track`: `popular` means a verified public GitHub repository with a dated Star snapshot, not firsthand evaluation; `practice` links project evidence of actual use, not third-party efficacy trials. Uncurated workflow notes and experimental protocols must not be described as vetted.

## Secondary historical examples
- [Previous editorial example index](https://openresearchassets.github.io/examples/README.md) (supporting reading, not a primary offering)

## Read first
- [AI 使用指南 / Agent guide](https://openresearchassets.github.io/for-agents/)
- [Compact AI manifest (JSON)](https://openresearchassets.github.io/catalog/manifest.json)
- [Canonical catalog (JSON)](https://openresearchassets.github.io/catalog/index.json)
- [Interactive discovery](https://openresearchassets.github.io/#references)
- [Actionable workflows: literature](https://openresearchassets.github.io/workflows/literature-triage.md)
- [Actionable workflows: experiments](https://openresearchassets.github.io/workflows/experiment-planning.md)
- [Actionable workflows: writing](https://openresearchassets.github.io/workflows/paper-evidence-story.md)
- [Actionable workflows: release](https://openresearchassets.github.io/workflows/research-release.md)
- [Asset schema & provenance](https://openresearchassets.github.io/docs/ASSET_SCHEMA.md)
- [Rights policy](https://openresearchassets.github.io/docs/ASSET_POLICY.md)

Suggested sequence: read compact manifest → select by task/stage/domain/kind → load only relevant `entry` JSON files (relative to site root) → check applicability and rights → verify resulting work.
